messages.subject: abou "Sys.sleep()" command
parts:
Hello every body,
my following program works fine when I run it in my R console. But when I run it in Shiny web apps, the function "Sys.sleep() does not work. It comes all at one  time, I want it to come one by one. Could any body have suggestion to my problem.

Thank you

Indra


## My R Program

x.range <- c(0,15)
y.range <- c(0,20)
heading <- paste("Counting Method of Addition")

plot(0,0, xlim= x.range, ylim = y.range, main =  heading, xlab = "", ylab = "",cex.main = 2, col.main = "red", axes = F, type = "n")
str <- c("one", "two", "three", "four", "five", "six", "seven", "eight", "nine", "ten", "eleven", "twelve", "thirteen", "fourteen", "fifteen", "sixteen", "seventeen", "eighteen")

text(1,19, "Addition Module using Marble counting", cex= 1.5, adj= c(0,0))
## Two random numbers for addend
num <- sample(0:9, 2, replace = T)
## render first number
text(3,15, num[1], cex = 3)
## make marbles (equal to first number)
text(4.5,15.5, "Count the marbles:", adj = c(0,0), cex = 1.2)
for(k in 1:num[1]){
    if(num[1]==0){text(4,15, "")
    if(num[1]==0){text(5, 14, "zero", adj = c(0,0))}
    }
    else{
    points(4+k, 15, pch=20, cex = 4, col = "blue")
    text(5 + (k-1), 14, str[k], adj = c(0,0))
    ##Sys.sleep(1)
    }
}
Sys.sleep(1)
text(2.5, 12, "+", cex = 3)
## render second number
text(3,12, num[2], cex = 3)
## make marbles (equal to second number)
text(4.5,12.5, "Continue Counting  marbles:", adj = c(0,0), cex = 1.2)
for(j in 1:num[2]){
    if(num[2]==0){
    text(4,12.0, "")
    text(5 , 11, "zero", adj = c(0,0))
    }
    else{
    points(4+j, 12.0, pch=20, cex = 4, col = "blue")
    text(5 + (j-1), 11, str[num[1]+j], adj = c(0,0))
    Sys.sleep(1)
    }
}

## line
segments(2.3,10.5, 3.5,10.5, lwd = 3)

sum <- num[1] + num[2]

text(3.0, 9.5, sum, cex = 3)
text(10,8, num[1], cex = 3)
text(9.5, 5, "+", cex = 3)
text(10,5, num[2], cex = 3)
segments(9.3, 3.5, 10.5, 3.5, lwd = 3)
text(9.8, 2, sum, cex= 3)
text(1,3,"Remember !!!", cex= 1.6, adj=c(0,0), col = "blue")
txt1 <- paste(num[1], "plus", num[2], "equals", sum)
text(1, 1.5, txt1, adj=c(0,0), cex = 2, col = "green")
rect(.8,1.0, 4.7,2.6, border = "green")
